pages.text: If you have a $(l:arcanearchives:gems/rivertear)Rivertear$(/l) somewhere in your inventory (or slotted in a $(l:arcanearchives:items/gemsocket)Gem Socket$(/l)), right clicking a Petal Apothecary will refill it with water.
Arcane Arsenal is not enabled; some features for this section are not present.
